# Request for Proposal: Managed IT Service Desk and End-User Support

Tender reference: NDSA-2026-ITSD-014. Issuer: National Digital Services Authority.

This is a synthetic document created for software testing. The issuer, the tender and all details are fictional.

## 1. Introduction

1.1 The Authority invites qualified suppliers to submit proposals for a three-year managed IT service desk covering 2,500 end users across three sites.

1.2 This RFP is published on Etimad and may be shared by bidders with their proposed subcontractors.

## 2. Eligibility and Legal Requirements

2.1 The bidder must hold a valid Commercial Registration issued in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

2.2 The bidder must be registered on the Etimad platform and hold a valid VAT registration certificate.

2.3 The bidder shall submit a valid Zakat certificate and GOSI certificate.

2.4 The bidder must have at least 8 years of experience in providing IT managed services.

2.5 The bidder shall demonstrate an average annual turnover of not less than SAR 30 million over the last three years, supported by audited financial statements.

2.6 Bidders must achieve a minimum local content score of 40% as certified by the Local Content and Government Procurement Authority (LCGPA).

2.7 The bidder must be in the Green band or above of the Nitaqat Saudization programme.

## 3. Certifications

3.1 The bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate.

3.2 The bidder must hold a valid ISO/IEC 27001 certificate covering service desk operations.

3.3 ISO/IEC 20000-1 certification is desirable and will be scored.

## 4. Past Performance

4.1 The bidder shall provide at least three similar projects completed in the last five years, each serving more than 1,000 end users, with client reference letters.

## 5. Technical Requirements

5.1 The service desk shall operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, in Arabic and English.

5.2 The solution must provide an ITSM platform aligned with ITIL 4 covering incident, problem, change and asset management.

5.3 All service management data must be hosted within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in a CST-licensed data centre.

5.4 The bidder shall comply with the NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-2:2024).

5.5 The bidder should describe its approach to self-service and knowledge management.

## 6. Service Levels

6.1 Priority 1 incidents must be responded to within 15 minutes and resolved within 4 hours.

6.2 The bidder shall guarantee service desk availability of 99.9% per month and propose service credits for breaches.

## 7. Team

7.1 The bidder shall nominate a dedicated Service Delivery Manager with at least 10 years of experience and ITIL 4 certification. CVs must be provided.

7.2 At least 60% of the on-site team must be Saudi nationals.

## 8. Implementation

8.1 The bidder shall submit a detailed transition plan covering the first 90 days, including knowledge transfer from the incumbent.

## 9. Commercial

9.1 The financial proposal must be submitted separately using the Authority's pricing schedule, in SAR, inclusive of VAT.

9.2 Prices shall remain valid for 120 days from the submission deadline.

9.3 Liquidated damages of up to 10% of the annual contract value will apply for SLA breaches.

## 10. Submission Instructions

10.1 Proposals must be submitted electronically via Etimad before the deadline. Late submissions will be disqualified.

10.2 The technical proposal must not exceed 80 pages, in PDF format, with font size no smaller than 11 points.

10.3 Bidders must submit a bid bond of 1% of the bid value valid for 90 days.

10.4 The bidder shall sign and submit the Integrity Pledge form (Annex B) and the Conflict of Interest declaration (Annex C).

## 11. Evaluation Criteria

| Criterion | Weight |
|---|---|
| Technical solution and ITSM platform | 30% |
| Service levels and quality | 20% |
| Team and key personnel | 15% |
| Past performance | 15% |
| Local content | 10% |
| Transition plan | 10% |

11.1 The technical proposal will be evaluated out of 100 points; bidders scoring below 70 points will be disqualified.

11.2 Technical evaluation carries 70% weight and financial evaluation 30%.
